name: web-grab
description: JS 渲染（SPA）站点抓取适配器 + 增强抓取插件：静态层只返回空壳时，自动探测数据接口并走站点适配器直连取数

scripts.export:json: node src/cli.mjs fetch https://www.mojinghub.com/competitions --all --format json --out out/competitions.json
scripts.export:csv: node src/cli.mjs fetch https://www.mojinghub.com/competitions --all --format csv --out out/competitions.csv
scripts.export:md: node src/cli.mjs fetch https://www.mojinghub.com/competitions --all --format md --out out/competitions.md
scripts.export:ics: node src/cli.mjs fetch https://www.mojinghub.com/competitions --all --format ics --ics-window both --ics-days all --out out/competitions.ics
